source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: A known, authorized repair has been applied to the intended course section. The agent has not read back the object and has two possible recipient addresses. What should happen before a success message is sent?

options.text: Verify the repaired behavior and establish the intended recipient.
options.feedback: An applied operation is not yet a verified outcome, and recipient ambiguity remains unresolved. Check both before communicating success and identify the automated responder.

options.text: Use the first address and describe the attempted change as a verified result.
options.feedback: List order does not establish the intended recipient. The claimed result also needs evidence from the affected object.

options.text: Send the same success message to both addresses to cover the uncertainty.
options.feedback: Broad delivery does not resolve who should receive the result. The workflow restricts the recipient and validates the repair before responding.

options.text: Ask the agent to confirm its confidence and reuse the most plausible address.
options.feedback: Confidence cannot substitute for inspecting the repaired behavior. A plausible address also needs to be established as the intended destination.
